text.p: SunPharm Corp said Tuesday it filed an Investigational New Drug (IND) application with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration to test SunPharm's proprietary polyamine analogue, DEHOP in ulcerative colitis patients.
Ulcerative colitis, a form of inflammatory bowel disease, is characterized by continuous inflammation in the rectum and colon, the company said.
If not treated, it often leads to the removal of the colon and/or colon cancer.
The company said inflammatory bowel disease, including ulcerative colitis and Crohn's disease, affects over two million people in the United States alone.
With no cure for these diseases, studies published in 1992 indicated that the total annual medical costs of both diseases were $1.4 to $1.8 billion, the company said.
